---
model: Claude Sonnet 4.5
---
Task:
1. Redesign the existing property card layout to improve visual clarity and usability.
2. Integrate a dynamic Google Map link using latitude and longitude details retrieved from the API for each property.
3. Display a Google Map icon prominently next to the complex name on each property card.
4. Enable users to click the map icon and be redirected directly to the property's location on Google Maps in a new browser tab.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. A visually refreshed property card layout reflecting modern design standards.
2. Functional integration of Google Maps based on API data (latitude and longitude).
3. Clearly positioned Google Map icon adjacent to the complex name for every property card.
4. Fully tested clickable map icon leading users to the correct address on Google Maps.
